name: Unified Date
description: A module to store a date field value in a unified date field on the base node table for multiple content type listing sorting.
project_description: Unified Date adds an unindexed timestamp base field named unified_date to every node and syncs a chosen per-bundle date source into it so multiple content types with different date fields can be sorted, filtered and listed together on one consistent value. Per node bundle you pick which field feeds the unified value (core created/changed/published_at base fields, a base field override, core datetime and datetime range, and contrib daterange_timezone and smartdate; the end_value of range fields is selectable). Bundles with nothing chosen fall back to the node created time. The value is (re)computed on every node presave; a batch form and two Drush commands (unified-date:write-all, unified-date:write-missing) backfill existing content. A Views filter plugin, a node token and a hook_unified_date alter hook are provided.
